izzyondroid:de.praecipitator.literaplaye.name: LiteraPlayer
izzyondroid:de.praecipitator.literaplaye.description:
LiteraPlayer
 LiteraPlayer was made to do one thing: play audiobooks from the file system. You give it access to a folder on your device, put audiobooks into it, and it plays them. No internet access, no accounts, no tracking, no ads, no AI slop.
 Usage
 When you first start the app, you will need to point it to a directory where your audiobooks are stored. Each audiobook must have it's own subfolder within this directory, containing the audio files and optionally a cover image. After that, you should see a list of all of your books. To play one, tap on it's play button on the right. Or tap the entry itself, and start playback from there.
 The app will remember the last book you played. You can resume it by pressing the floating play button to the bottom right of the main screen. If you use the homescreen widget, you can also use that to start playback without even opening the app.
 If you added new books to your audiobook directory, you might need to resynchronize the app. To do this, simply swipe downwards on the main list, or select "Refresh Audiobooks" from the menu in the top right corner. The app will compare it's internal database to the file system, adding what you added, and removing what you deleted. (The latter can be disabled in the settings)
 You can also add more than one source directory. The app will then combine the books of all of them into one unified list. Keep in mind that if you remove a directory, all the books within it will be removed from the app (but not from the file system)!
 Features
 Fully offline: the app doesn't even request the internet permission.
 No file manager permission: the app will only request permissions for the folders you give it, not for the entire file system.
 Supports pretty much any format Android is capable of playing.
 Available in three languages: english, german, russian.
 If available, the title and cover of a book are fetched from the audio file metadata. If an image exists within the book's folder, it will always be used instead.
 Media player controls as a notification and on the lockscreen while playback is in progress, with configurable quick actions.
 Playback can also be controlled through buttons on connected headphones, if available.
 A responsive homescreen widget to control playback of the current audiobook.
 Dark or Light theme for the app, either depending on the system's theme, or chosen manually.
 Dark or Light theme for the widgets, either depending on the app's theme, or chosen manually.
 A sleep timer can be used to automatically fade out and stop playback after a given time.
 Bookmarks can be set at any point within an audiobook, in order to quickly jump to a certain moment.
 When resuming playback, the app will rewind by a few seconds to remind you where you were (configurable).
 No LLMs whatsoever have been used in the creation of this app.
 Permissions requested
 READ_PHONE_STATE : Used to automatically pause when the phone rings, and to resume afterwards. Can be denied, this feature will then be unavailable. The app can be prevented from ever requesting it by disabling it in the Settings.
 WAKE_LOCK : Required to prevent the device from going to sleep during playback.
 POST_NOTIFICATIONS : Required for the media controls notification.
 FOREGROUND_SERVICE : Required for the playback service.
 FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK : Required for the playback service.

Listening progress is saved during playback and on pause. History, bookmarks, checkpoints before jumps, and undo help you return to an earlier position.

On OPPO, OnePlus and realme phones, turn on Music playback under Live Alerts in Settings to see these controls on the lock screen. The app stores its library and listening history only on your device. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes that data, leaving your original audio files untouched.

fdroid:de.hexenwoche.audiolex.name: AudioLex
fdroid:de.hexenwoche.audiolex.summary: Hearing training for word recognition: listen, identify, repeat. Fully offline.
fdroid:de.hexenwoche.audiolex.description:
AudioLex trains the understanding of spoken words for the case where hearing and understanding come apart: the sound arrives, but it is no longer reliably decoded as speech. That happens after one-sided hearing loss, and a hearing aid alone does not fix it — it makes things louder, not clearer. The path from sound to word has to be practised again.
Two modes, both aimed at the same thing:
Learning mode — a word is played with its text visible. This builds the link between what arrives and what it means.
Exam mode — the word is played, the card stays covered. You rate yourself. That rating decides when the word comes back: after a minute, after ten, after a day, a week or a month.
Hearing and reading at the same time also helps with spelling: in learning mode you hear a word and see how it is written. That works for the bundled words and for your own recordings alike.
92 words and sentences are included: 72 in German — 68 from free speech synthesis, four spoken by real voices — and 20 in English. Which language you train is a setting of its own, separate from the language of the interface. Your own recordings can be added: speak a word or sentence, write it down, train it. Several speakers can be kept apart and switched on or off individually — a familiar voice is a different exercise from a stranger's.
For harder practice, put a background noise under the speech and set the distance between the two in decibels. Three levels do it in one tap: easy without noise, hard with a clear speech advantage, advanced with the noise above the speech. One noise is included, recorded inside a bus. Your own can be recorded or imported as WAV files.
For headphone training there is a channel choice — left, right or both — which helps when only one ear should be trained. Over a Bluetooth hearing aid, stereo is summed to mono; the app detects this and shows the channel choice as ineffective instead of pretending otherwise.
What AudioLex does not do: it requests no internet permission, has no account, no trackers, no ads. Vocabulary, ratings and session history stay on the device — not as a promise, but because the app has no technical way to send anything. A backup writes your own recordings, your own noises and the session history to a ZIP file in your documents when you ask it to. What happens to that file afterwards is up to you.
AudioLex is a practice tool, not a medical product. It replaces neither an audiologist's advice nor an ENT examination.
The app was built for one person with exactly this problem. It shows: it is plain, and it does not explain itself — the short guide inside is where it tries. The interface speaks German or English, switchable on the start screen.

fdroid:org.calyxinstitute.vpn.name: Calyx VPN

fdroid:org.calyxinstitute.vpn.description:
With CalyxVPN, you can safely encrypt all your network traffic and route it through the Calyx Institute.
• Anonymous VPN: No user accounts and no logging.
• Anonymous IP Address: When the VPN connection is active, all the servers on the internet will see you as originating from an anonymous IP hosted by Calyx.
• Free: This is a free service provided by the Calyx Institute.
• Open Source: Both the client and server are 100% free and open source software.
• No IPv6 Leaks: CalyxVPN will not leak IPv6 traffic (requires root).
• No DNS Leaks: CalyxVPN is configured on both the client and the server to prevent any leaking of DNS. All DNS requests are anonymously handled by Calyx when the VPN is on.
• Circumvention: When "Use Bridges" option is enabled, all your traffic is hidden as normal web traffic, in order to circumvent some censorship systems that block VPN traffic.
As with all VPNs, CalyxVPN only adds security to your data as it flows over the network. It cannot protect the content of your data that is stored or that you give to a website. It also does not prevent advertising and tracking in your apps or web browser (except when this tracking is based on your IP address).

flathub:io.gitlab.zulfian1732.munquet.name: Munquet
flathub:io.gitlab.zulfian1732.munquet.description:
Munquet is a lightweight desktop tool for converting and preparing tabular data files with ease.
 Transform structured data into the efficient Apache Parquet format, reduce file size, merge datasets, and validate column structures — all through a simple graphical interface.
 Key features:
 Convert CSV/TSV files to Parquet
 Merge multiple datasets into one
 Validate and rename column headers safely
 Prevent inconsistent or mismatched data
 Batch processing with progress feedback
 Works fully offline

flathub:io.sourceforge.zaz.name: Zaz
flathub:io.sourceforge.zaz.summary: Puzzle game where the player has to arrange balls in triplets
flathub:io.sourceforge.zaz.description:
Zaz (Zaz ain't Z***) is a game where the player has to get rid of incoming
 balls by arranging them in triplets. The idea of the game is loosely based on
 games like Luxor, Zuma and Puzzle Bobble. The twists that make Zaz stand out
 from other games of this type are that the balls have to be picked from the path
 (insted of being randomly assigned for the player) and that the player's "vehicle"
 is also attached to a path which is different from level to level.

flathub:org.jjazzlab.JJazzLab.name: JJazzLab
flathub:org.jjazzlab.JJazzLab.summary: Generate backing tracks for any song
flathub:org.jjazzlab.JJazzLab.description:
Fed up with boring backing tracks? Try JJazzLab and make your own dynamic backing tracks in just a few minutes!
 "Love it, works as expected, wow, thanks to the author" - "Absolutely fantastic app!" (YouTube comments)
 Features:
 Dynamic backing tracks - Create professional-quality backing tracks that breathe with real musicality.
 Musically alive - Add variety, rhythmic accents and natural dynamics that keep your practice sessions inspiring.
 Hundreds of styles at your fingertips - Master jazz standards with the signature jjSwing style, or explore any genre using compatible Yamaha style files for endless possibilities.
 Simple user interface - Type in a few chord symbols, choose a style and hit play. No complex setup required.
 Grows with your skills - Whether you're working on a simple blues or a complex composition with multiple sections and tempo changes, JJazzLab adapts to your needs.
 Open-source platform for musicians and developers - JJazzLab welcomes community contributions, custom plugins, and new music generation features that keep evolving.

flathub:org.xfce.ristretto.description:
Ristretto is an image viewer for the Xfce desktop environment.
 The Ristretto Image Viewer is an application that can be used to view
 and scroll through images, run a slideshow of images, open images with
 other applications like an image-editor or configure an image as the
 desktop wallpaper.

flathub:page.codeberg.foolish.Flipbook.name: Flipbook
flathub:page.codeberg.foolish.Flipbook.description:
**This app is in early development. There may be bugs and incomplete/missing features!**
 Create hand-drawn animations with a simple, streamlined experience. It is designed to let you
 focus on your art. Colors are automatically saved inside the project and can be exported and imported
 to others. Images can be imported as frames into a project. There are multiple brush styles to
 choose from.

flathub:vc.dion.Dion.name: Dion
flathub:vc.dion.Dion.description:
Video conferencing service with a hybrid cloud infrastructure.
 A full-featured video conferencing system from DION with extensive capabilities for comfortable
 communication: high-quality audio and video, support for up to 5,000 users, guaranteed security,
 and much more.
 A custom corporate social video network with channels, communication, and video sharing.
 Create, share, and engage users in a secure and controlled environment. Meeting recordings are
 stored on a video hosting platform, where any call can be automatically transcribed and recorded
 in just a few clicks.
 Full-fledged chats for personal and group communication with extensive functionality: from
 editing to forwarding messages.
 A solution from DION that lets you host events of any size. Get all the features you need:
 quick and easy event creation, inviting guests using a variety of scenarios, and live streaming.
 A meeting room booking and management system that will replace expensive imported alternatives.
 Create, modify, and cancel bookings, and conduct meetings with a single solution from DION.

firefox-addons:3022035.summary: Blur WhatsApp Web & Telegram Web chats, previews, names, profile pictures and media until you hover. Press Alt+X to toggle, Alt+C to open settings. Pick exactly what to blur; auto-blurs when idle or when you switch away.
firefox-addons:3022035.description:
WhatsApp Web Privacy Mode keeps your conversations private in public, on calls,
and while screen-sharing. It blurs sensitive content and reveals it only when
you move your mouse over it. Works on both WhatsApp Web and Telegram Web, and
each one keeps its own independent settings.
SUPPORTED SITES
• WhatsApp Web: web.whatsapp.com 
• Telegram Web: web.telegram.org (the "A" / web.telegram.org/a/ client)
WHAT IT CAN BLUR (turn each on/off independently, each with its own strength):
• Chat messages (text in the open conversation)
• Message previews in the chat list: including Archived chats
• Contact & group names (chat list and chat header)
• Profile pictures / avatars
• Media: photos, videos, stickers and GIFs
• Link previews for shared URLs (title, description and domain)
• Call logs: voice, video and missed calls (WhatsApp)
• The message input box (dims what you type)
HOW TO USE
• Everything sensitive is blurred. Hover over any item to reveal just that item;
 move away and it blurs again. No clicks needed.
• Click the toolbar icon (or press Alt+C) to open the panel and choose exactly
 what gets blurred. A WhatsApp / Telegram switcher at the top lets each site
 keep its own settings.
• Press Alt+X to turn Privacy Mode on or off at any time.
MESSAGES TO SHOW (open conversation)
Choose which messages stay visible: All · None (hide all) · Mine only ·
Theirs only · or just the Last N messages.
OPENED DOCUMENTS (WhatsApp)
WhatsApp opens PDFs and other attachments in its own viewer. The content opens
blurred behind a "Show content" button, while the header above it stays sharp so
the file name, Star, Download and Close keep working on a document you have not
revealed yet. Reveal it when you are ready; it blurs itself again after a set
time (default 60 seconds, adjustable in the panel) and the moment you switch to
another tab.
SMART AUTO-BLUR
• Blur when idle: blurs the whole app after a few seconds of no activity.
• Blur when inactive: blurs everything the moment you switch to another tab or
 window (great for screen-sharing).
• Panic key: press Alt+Z to instantly blur the entire app; press again to restore.
ALLOWED CHATS (trusted exceptions)
Exempt specific chats and choose how much of them shows: everything, name +
picture only, or only certain messages (mine / theirs / last N). Add a chat
instantly with Alt+right-click, or type its exact name.
REDACTION STYLE
Pick frosted blur or solid black redaction bars.
TELEGRAM CHAT CLEANUP (Telegram only)
Tidy up junk chats in one go. Press "Clean up now" and the add-on finds contact
"joined Telegram" notifications and "Deleted Account" chats, shows you a preview,
and, only after you confirm, deletes them one at a time (with a Stop button).
You review everything before anything is removed, and it never runs on its own.
KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS
• Alt+X: turn Privacy Mode on / off
• Alt+C: open the settings panel
• Alt+Z: panic: blur everything (press again to restore)
• Alt+right-click a chat: add / remove it from the allow-list
On a Mac, press Option (⌥) instead of Alt: ⌥X, ⌥C, ⌥Z, ⌥+right-click.
(Shortcuts work on the open WhatsApp / Telegram tab.)
PRIVACY
This add-on runs only on web.whatsapp.com and web.telegram.org . It does not
collect, send, sell or store any data. All settings stay in your browser. It
only needs "storage" (to remember your preferences) and access to those two
sites (to apply the blur). No analytics, no trackers, no remote code.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp, Telegram or Meta.

FOCUS MODE

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No network requests, no analytics, no tracking. Your settings and pictures stay in your browser.
HOW TO USE
1. Click the LeetCode Theme icon in the toolbar.
2. Choose a theme or tap a wallpaper.
3. Open any problem on leetcode.com — your new look is already there.

apple-itunes:1100131368.description:
Lightspeed Scanner is the mobile companion app for the Lightspeed Retail (X-Series) Point-of-Sale (POS) system.
This app allows users to manage their Lightspeed product catalog, sell to customers, and handle product inventory from the convenience of a mobile phone. Lightspeed Scanner turns your device's camera into a powerful barcode reader, making it fast and easy to identify and count products from your Retail catalog.
Key features of Lightspeed Scanner:
• Add or edit products: Record Name, Description, Price, SKU Codes, Locations, and Product Images directly to your Lightspeed Retail catalog.
• Sell from anywhere: Turn your phone into a mobile register. Accept payment via Tap to Pay for iPhone (Lightspeed Payments users only), sell On Account, or Park sales to complete them on any in-store register.
• View product information: Search your product catalog and view details like price, stock levels, descriptions, and images.
• Inventory management: Perform or schedule full and partial inventory counts. Create or add to supplier purchase orders and outlet transfer orders. You can also receive stock, fulfill transfers, and record inventory adjustments. For additional accuracy, inventory and orders counted on the app must be completed on the Lightspeed Retail POS system, giving managers ultimate control of inventory movements.
Key use cases for Lightspeed Scanner:
• Mobile clienteling: Quick access to the catalog makes this a great tool for sales associates assisting customers on the shop floor. Staff can check pricing and availability without leaving the customer's side.
• Mobile selling: Enable stores to sell from anywhere, such as pop-up events or on the shop floor. Lightspeed Scanner allows you to offer dynamic, personalized shopping experiences.
• Mobile catalog management: Edit your Lightspeed product catalog from anywhere to ensure details are always up to date. Changes made in the app sync directly with ecommerce systems connected to Lightspeed Retail.
• Mobile order management: Picking and packing orders is simple on Lightspeed Scanner. With the app installed on your phone, you can pick orders without carrying additional hardware.
• Finding inventory quickly: Check inventory levels across multiple outlets. Product locations are visible and editable within the app, allowing staff to quickly navigate to where products are stored.
• Recording needs: Use the List building function to easily record products that need to be re-stocked, re-labelled, marked as damaged, or transferred to another outlet.
Hardware and Syncing:
• The app syncs directly with your POS system via WiFi or mobile network, ensuring all actions are visible instantly on the Lightspeed Retail system.
• Users of Lightspeed Retail who prefer infrared barcode readers over the built-in camera scanner can connect Socket barcode readers directly to Lightspeed Scanner.
